Step 1: 1218 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1218 not divisible by 4).  
Step 2: From 11-23, remaining days in 1218:  
Nov: 30 - 23 = 7 days left in Nov.  
Dec: 31 days. Total remaining in 1218 = 7 + 31 = 38 days.  
Step 3: 283 total days to add. After using 38 days, we reach end of 1218.  
Days left into next year: 283 - 38 = 245 days into 1219.  
Step 4: 1219 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = sum first 8 months = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
245 - 243 = 2 days into September 1219.  
So date = 1219-09-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1219-09-02
